设计意图： Preserves the parent's asymmetric overnight-versus-intraday downside mechanism, but smooths the noise by lengthening the lookback and replacing the more volatile intraday volatility denominator with the average daily range. The intent is to keep the same economic story: stocks with sustained negative overnight pressure and weak intraday recovery should score higher, while reducing spike sensitivit

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

log(1 + (ts_mean(-min(overnight_ret,0)) + 0.5*ts_mean(abs(close_ret))) / (ts_mean(max(intraday_ret,0)) + ts_mean(high-low)))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

算子

算子含义
loglog(x) → 自然对数
ts_meants_mean(x, n) → 滚动均值
minmin(x, n) → 滚动最小 / 逐点最小
absabs(x) → 绝对值
maxmax(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

log(1 + (ts_mean(-min(overnight_ret,0)) + 0.5*ts_mean(abs(close_ret))) / (ts_mean(max(intraday_ret,0)) + ts_mean(high-low)))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. log —— 取自然对数
    log(add(1, divide(add(ts_mean((-(overnight_ret min 0))), multiply(0.5, ts_mean(abs(close_ret)))), add(ts_mean((intraday_ret max 0)), ts_mean(subtract(high, low))))))
  2. 2. add —— 加法
    add(1, divide(add(ts_mean((-(overnight_ret min 0))), multiply(0.5, ts_mean(abs(close_ret)))), add(ts_mean((intraday_ret max 0)), ts_mean(subtract(high, low)))))
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(add(ts_mean((-(overnight_ret min 0))), multiply(0.5, ts_mean(abs(close_ret)))), add(ts_mean((intraday_ret max 0)), ts_mean(subtract(high, low))))
  4. 4. add —— 加法
    add(ts_mean((-(overnight_ret min 0))), multiply(0.5, ts_mean(abs(close_ret))))
  5. 5. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((-(overnight_ret min 0)))
  6. 6. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(0.5, ts_mean(abs(close_ret)))
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(abs(close_ret))
  8. 8. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(close_ret)
  9. 9. add —— 加法
    add(ts_mean((intraday_ret max 0)), ts_mean(subtract(high, low)))
  10. 10. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((intraday_ret max 0))
  11. 11. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(subtract(high, low))
  12. 12. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(high, low)
使用字段：
列含义说明
highhigh（中间变量/衍生量）
lowlow（中间变量/衍生量）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 down_overnight：(-overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0)).滚动窗口(18, min_periods=18).mean()
  2. 计算 up_intraday：intraday_ret.clip(lower=0.0).滚动窗口(18, min_periods=18).mean()
  3. 计算 range_：(high - low).滚动窗口(18, min_periods=18).mean()
  4. 计算 close_vol：close.pct_change().abs().滚动窗口(18, min_periods=18).mean()
  5. 计算 asym：(down_overnight + 0.5 * close_vol) / (up_intraday + range_ + 1e-12)
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

volume成交量基础行情字段

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. min(overnight_ret,0) — min(x, n) → 滚动最小 / 逐点最小
  2. abs(close_ret) — abs(x) → 绝对值
  3. max(intraday_ret,0) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  4. mean(high-low) — mean(x, n) → 滚动均值

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_overnight_intraday_downside_smoothing(df): df_copy = df.copy() overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) down_overnight = (-overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0)).rolling(18, min_periods=18).mean() up_intraday = intraday_ret.clip(lower=0.0).rolling(18, min_periods=18).mean() range_ = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(18, min_periods=18).mean() close_vol = df_copy["close"].pct_change().abs().rolling(18, min_periods=18).mean() asym = (down_overnight + 0.5 * close_vol) / (up_intraday + range_ + 1e-12) df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_downside_smoothing"] = np.log1p(asym) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_downside_smoothing"]
